description: Comprehensive ground-truth benchmark results from 9 published robotics papers for ORBIT profiler validation and learned quality predictor training. Each entry records the best-reported success rate for a given (dataset, task, policy) combination. Restricted to vision-based manipulation datasets; state-only benchmarks (D4RL locomotion) excluded as methodological choice.
